description: This file defines the Arabic (Yemen) culture information for the DateJS library, including localized date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing, timezone info, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing the current date with time cleared.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Date objects, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name, abbreviated name, or shortest name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviated name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name based on offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Checks if the date is between start and end dates.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if the date is after another date.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if the date is before another date.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if the date is today.

methods.name: isSameDay
methods.description: Checks if the date is the same as another date.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the date.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds seconds to the date.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Adds minutes to the date.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Adds hours to the date.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Adds days to the date.

methods.name: addWeeks
methods.description: Adds weeks to the date.

methods.name: addMonths
methods.description: Adds months to the date.

methods.name: addYears
methods.description: Adds years to the date.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components at once, including timezone and week.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Sets the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Sets the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the Nth occurrence of a weekday in its month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific day of week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific month.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the date within its month.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone based on offset or name.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if daylight saving time is observed.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the current date is in daylight saving time.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset in HH:MM format.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed between the date and another date.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts date to ISO string format.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the date to string based on format pattern.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes parsing and formatting components for a string.
